title: Deep learning distinguishes eyes with prior optic neuritis on peripapillary OCT ring scans
summary: A dilated residual convolutional neural network classified OCT peripapillary ring scans from healthy eyes (1033 scans) and eyes with prior optic neuritis (510 scans from 140 MS patients). The network reached accuracy 0.85 and AUC 0.86, against AUC 0.77 for retinal nerve fiber layer thickness alone. On an independent second-center set (61 optic neuritis scans, 102 healthy scans) accuracy was 0.77 and AUC 0.90, against 0.84 for thickness. The authors call this feasibility.
